fig: Illustration of Hajj Care Medical Check-Up
title: Hajj Care Medical Check-Up
body:
Maintaining good health is essential for prospective Hajj pilgrims, as the climate and environment in Saudi Arabia are significantly different from those in Indonesia. Differences in temperature, humidity, food, and social and cultural conditions may affect the health of pilgrims during their journey.

To help prevent health problems and ensure pilgrims are physically fit for Hajj, it is highly recommended to undergo a Medical Check-Up (MCU) before departure.

In Indonesia, the health assessment for prospective Hajj pilgrims is conducted in several stages.

The first health examination is performed at a community health center (Puskesmas) to evaluate the pilgrim's overall health condition and determine whether they are medically fit to perform the Hajj pilgrimage.

The second stage is carried out by the District or Municipal Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan). During this examination, pilgrims undergo a follow-up medical assessment, receive the Meningococcal Meningitis vaccination, and female pilgrims of childbearing age are required to take a pregnancy test.
